entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing Sichuan countryside hand-painted travel postcard, texture-balance revision.
Input: Image 1 is the ONLY image and ONLY edit target, the latest v6 simplified illustration. Preserve its exact composition and all story elements.
Primary request: the last cleanup made the painting a little TOO pristine and too smoothly polished/animation-like. Increase the amount of VISIBLE HAND-PAINTED MATERIAL TEXTURE by approximately 30% RELATIVE TO THIS CURRENT v6 IMAGE. Aim for a moderate, perceptible single-step increase (about 1.3 times the current texture), not a full restoration of the earlier busy version. Do not make a radical style change.
What to add: selectively repaint a modest extra layer of tactile gouache/dry-brush marks in the foreground wood and the broad ground planes. Use a few varied, softly broken pigment strokes, irregular worn patches and slightly rough paint edges, with light/dark differences in the existing local colors. Keep marks sparse, deliberately grouped and medium/coarse rather than pixel-sized; plenty of uninterrupted base color remains between them. This should look genuinely painted and slightly rustic, not like smooth cel-shaded anime scenery and not like artificial noise.
Tree: keep the current brown base, broad curved light plane and darker underside. Add a restrained scattering of short irregular bark breaks alongside the long directional grooves, a few worn tan/umber brush patches following the curvature. Stop well before dense tiled bark scales, all-over gray chips or camouflage.
Ground: add lightly broken dry-brush tonal variations to currently very smooth areas, keeping the correct material, intact base planes and existing contact shadows. Added marks should enrich the surface without dominating it. Preserve the current LARGE CONNECTED TREE-SHADE shapes and direction of sunlight. Only gently roughen some shadow edges; do NOT recreate the carpet of tiny disconnected leaf silhouettes or glittering sun flecks that was removed.
Leaves/background: a little subtle hand-brushed color variation inside selected larger foliage planes is fine, but preserve all silhouettes and leave most leaves simple. Do not add a new all-over paper/canvas/noise overlay, sharpen edges, change saturation, or alter depth of field. It remains the same warm Chinese countryside gouache/watercolor illustration.
STRICT identity/layout locks: one toad and one satchel stay exactly where they are on the foreground branch, same scale, pose, amber eye, orange glands, olive body, cream belly edge, short limbs and main wart spots. Keep the blue bag's white flower, brass clasp and red chili knot. Do not increase the toad's wart density or draw texture across its eyes, face or bag emblem. Preserve every human, their expressions, actions, clothing and every prop's location, scale and geometry. No new characters, no moved furniture, no changed camera angle/crop, no labels/borders/watermark. Output a full opaque native1536x1024 3:2 landscape illustration.
Specific scene: keep both human men at center-right doing ear cleaning, the reclining bamboo chair, gaiwan, towel and dark tool roll; the toad is watching from the tree. Preserve the gray stone paving grid and coherent moss seams. Add the modest extra dry-brush variation inside slab faces and restrained bark breaks on the large foreground branch; keep the ear-cleaning hand/tool gesture clear. Preserve the teahouse, umbrellas and empty bamboo tables. No text.
